LSO.note: States nothing on rules or an authority for AI harms.
The AI is inside the health sector, not general administration.

facts.fact: Qure.ai's account says its qXR chest X-ray AI has screened for TB at seven community sites in Lesotho with Partners In Health and the Ministry of Health since July 2022.
Qure.ai reports that qXR has processed over 6,000 scans since July 2022 and identified about 1,100 people with potential TB for GeneXpert confirmation.

LSO.note: qXR is a foreign vendor product; no local development or computing stated.
